project.name: jawelte (db-testdata-module aggregator)
project.description: Fluent DB fixture loader (DbSeed) and verifier (DbDiff) for integration tests. DbSeed.forConnection(...) / forPersistenceUnit(...) drive DbUnit-backed clean-insert / insert / update / refresh modes; DbDiff.assertEquals() reports cell- and row-level differences with table[row].column + 1-based expected-line locators; assertRowCount(...) compares against a SELECT COUNT(*). Two format SPI ports (DbSeedEngine, DbDiffEngine) ship default impls for the dbunit-xml format at @Priority(Integer.MAX_VALUE); a third api/port (ELInterpolator) drives the ${expr} interpolation step that runs before each engine call. The PU-to-Connection bridge (PersistenceUnitConnectionResolver) is owned by jpa-module and resolved via TestContext.loadService(...) at call time.
